name: qfd_coll_face_p_pinwin-ppinwin-COMMIT
purpose: CB16c-COLL2-FB 10-22 (FALLBACK, parallel to the CB16c-COLL regional split): qfd_coll_face_p_regional5_main unchanged (RTL, 6 macros, 12 roots, landing / clock-region hooks, SDC, CTS settings) except W/E pin_ranges windows: every bus clustered beside its owning band with its clock entry pin adjacent (tx_data 405-475 + cal_ck 476 over the cal band; rx_data 160-230 + rx_rck 231 over the rx band; phy_rx 395-470 / codec0p 471 / phy_tx 473-548 on the phy band; clock-only entries tx_wck/tx_rck/rx_wck/cal_lck/codec2-4 at their band centres). Cause: route.pin_balance laid each face out alphabetically over the 907-um edge, so each root's boundary pin flops spanned ~450 um (S0 r7 FB cal_ck 82.8 ps, S0 r7 MAIN 150.2, P r5 MAIN 263.5 > 80 ps TT). 546/597-b buses at 0.126-0.128 um/pin (>= 0.096 = M4 2 tracks). No RTL change.
